title: Conditions of Sale: Named Holders, Date Changes and Transfer
content:
These conditions govern the naming of the holder, the moving of a named ski date and the passing of an order to another person across the Lift Tickets line of Granite Ridge Mountain Collective.

1. **Naming.** A product is sold either with the person who will use it named on the order or without. The three flex and collective packs name that person; the Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket and the two advance tickets do not.
2. **Moving a named ski date.** Each product states whether a named ski date may be moved to another date, the fee for moving it, and the number of calendar days before the ski date by which the change must be recorded. The Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket does not permit a move; every other product in the line does.
3. **Re-registration.** Each product states whether the order may be re-registered to a different named holder and the fee for doing so. Only the three packs permit it.
4. **Transfer between guests.** Each product states whether an unused day may be used by anyone holding the media. The Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket and the two advance tickets carry that liberty; the three packs do not.

## Schedule of terms

| Product | Holder named on the order | Named ski date may be moved | Date change fee | Notice before the ski date | Re-registration permitted | Re-registration fee | An unused day usable by anyone holding the media |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Window Day Ticket | no | no | USD 0.00 | 0 days | no | USD 0.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket | no | yes | USD 25.00 | 2 days | no | USD 0.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket | no | yes | USD 20.00 | 3 days | no | USD 0.00 | yes |
| Granite Ridge Flex 4-Day Ticket Pack | yes | yes | USD 0.00 | 0 days | yes | USD 15.00 | no |
| Granite Ridge Flex 8-Day Ticket Pack | yes | yes | USD 0.00 | 0 days | yes | USD 15.00 | no |
| Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack | yes | yes | USD 0.00 | 0 days | yes | USD 25.00 | no |

The two figures that differ across the line are the date change fee, charged at USD 25.00 on the Granite Ridge 3-Day Advance Ticket and USD 20.00 on the Granite Ridge 7-Day Advance Ticket, and the re-registration fee, charged at USD 15.00 on the two flex packs and USD 25.00 on the Granite Ridge Collective Multi-Mountain Ticket Pack.
